ticket: Can't log in after resetting my password this morning
steps: Check if the password reset was successful by trying to log in with the new password | Verify that the password reset was not a result of a network issue or a temporary glitch | Try resetting the password again and attempt to log in with the new password | Check the email account used for password reset to ensure the password reset link was sent correctly | Contact the IT department for further assistance if none of the above steps resolve the issue

ticket: The whole second floor has no internet
steps: Check the router and modem to ensure they are turned on and functioning properly. | Verify that the network cables are securely connected to the router and computers. | Check the network settings on the router and computers to ensure they are set to the correct network and subnet masks. | Restart the router and modem to see if the issue resolves itself.

ticket: Printer says "offline" but it's turned on
steps: Check the power cord and ensure it's securely plugged in. | Verify the printer is turned on and not in sleep mode. | Try pressing the 'Resume' or 'Cancel' button on the printer to see if it will turn back on. | Check the printer's paper tray and ink levels to ensure they are not empty or low. | Try restarting the printer and see if the issue persists.

ticket: Outlook keeps crashing when I open attachments
steps: Check for any recent updates or patches for Microsoft Office and ensure they are installed correctly. | Try opening the attachment in a different email client to isolate the issue. | Disable any attachments or macros from the attachment to see if it resolves the issue.

ticket: My account got locked after too many tries
steps: Check if the lockout policy is enabled and adjust the number of failed login attempts if necessary | Try resetting the password using the 'Forgot Password' option | Check the account lockout history to see if there are any other issues that may have caused the lockout

ticket: Wi-Fi is really slow in the break room
steps: Restart the Wi-Fi router in the break room to see if it resolves the issue. | Check if there are any other devices connected to the same network and try to isolate the issue. | Verify that the Wi-Fi settings are correct and that the network is set to the correct channel. | Check for any physical obstructions between the router and the break room that could be affecting the signal.

ticket: Need Excel installed on my new computer
steps: Check if the Excel installation package is included in the operating system installation or if it was installed separately. | Verify if the Excel installation is corrupted or damaged by trying to run it and see if it opens. | Check for any available updates for Excel and install them if necessary.

ticket: The shared drive is gone, nobody can open team files
steps: Check if the shared drive is still accessible from another computer on the network. | Verify if the team files are still stored on the shared drive and not on individual workstations. | Try accessing the shared drive from a different user account to see if the issue is specific to a particular account. | Check the event logs for any errors related to the shared drive or team files. | Contact the IT administrator to report the issue and request assistance in recovering the shared drive.

ticket: My keyboard is missing a few keys
steps: Check if the missing keys are loose and can be reattached | Inspect the keyboard for any physical damage or debris | Try using a different keyboard to see if the issue is specific to the missing keys | Contact the manufacturer or a professional repair service for assistance

ticket: New hire starts Monday and needs an account set up
steps: Verify the new hire's email address and phone number to ensure they have the necessary contact information for the company. | Check the company's HR system to see if the new hire's information is already on file. | Create a new account for the new hire in the company's HR system and ensure all necessary permissions are set. | Send a confirmation email to the new hire with their login credentials and a link to the company's intranet.
